agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py's group_comments(): the condition guarding the token_prev/group_tokens call was inverted (`if not (end is not None):`), causing group_tokens to be invoked with a None end index when no trailing non-comment token was found, which raised TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'NoneType' and 'bool' inside sql.py's group_tokens (end_idx = end + include_end). Corrected the condition to `if end is not None:` so grouping of Comment tokens only proceeds when a valid end token was located, matching the intended/original logic. Verified via manual sqlparse.format(..., strip_comments=True) smoke tests covering single-line comments, multi-line comments, SQL hints (preserved), trailing comments, and comment-only / newline-adjacent cases — no crashes, and hint-preservation plus comment stripping work as expected. Also confirmed normal reindent/formatting paths unaffected.
